purpose: Ensure critical raw SCB/Raps inputs remain traceable to explicit table IDs, non-empty files and documented selections.
requiredChecks: every required source is present in data/raw/manifest.json
every source has a non-empty SCB/Raps table identifier
every source points to an existing non-empty raw file
manifest row counts contain at least one data row plus header
every downloaded source records a non-empty selection
pre-CKM population/calibration sources stop no later than 2024
the CKM base-population source explicitly contains 2025
governance: Source provenance is a hard production requirement.
A changed SCB table ID or dimension selection must remain visible in the manifest.
Frozen historical files may be reused only with retained manifest metadata.
